categories.main_business_segments: LS Eco Energy Ltd. operates primarily as a foreign-invested holding company controlling subsidiaries engaged in power cables and materials manufacturing. Its main subsidiaries include LS-VINA Cable & System Joint Stock Co. and LS Cable & System Vietnam Co., Ltd. in Vietnam, producing high, medium, and low voltage power cables, communication cables (UTP, optical fiber), and busducts, and LS-Gaon Cable Myanmar Co., Ltd. in Myanmar focusing on low voltage power cables. The company is also expanding into new business areas such as rare earth materials supply and subsea cable investments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s subsidiaries utilize advanced cable manufacturing technologies including continuous production processes for power and communication cables, with specialized facilities for copper rod and aluminum rod production. They employ Make-to-Order (MTO) manufacturing tailored to customer specifications, leveraging LS Group’s expertise in non-ferrous metal refining and cable technology. The company is also developing subsea cable technology in collaboration with partners and plans to internalize rare earth refining technologies through domestic research collaborations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include national power utilities such as Vietnam Electricity (EVN), large EPC contractors (ABB, Alstom, Siemens), telecommunications operators, and construction companies in Vietnam and Myanmar. The company serves both domestic markets and exports to regions including North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Key markets are power infrastructure, renewable energy projects (notably wind power), and high-speed communication networks (5G).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Southeast Asia, primarily Vietnam and Myanmar. Vietnam hosts the major production subsidiaries in Haiphong and Ho Chi Minh City, while Myanmar operations are based in Yangon’s Thilawa Special Economic Zone. The company also targets export markets in North America, Europe, and neighboring ASEAN countries such as Cambodia, Laos, Bangladesh, and the Philippines.
categories.supply_chain_position: LS Eco Energy operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of power and communication cables and related materials. It controls subsidiaries that produce raw materials like copper and aluminum rods, cable manufacturing, and assembly. The company also acts as a holding entity providing strategic oversight and support services to its subsidiaries, positioning itself upstream in terms of resource control and midstream in manufacturing and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-value product lines such as high-voltage and subsea cables to capture growing renewable energy markets, especially offshore wind power in Vietnam. The company is investing in rare earth material supply and rare metal alloy production to secure critical materials for permanent magnets used in eco-friendly technologies. R&D efforts focus on product improvement, design, and testing in collaboration with LS Cable & System and domestic research institutes to internalize refining technologies and enhance cable performance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of power cables, communication cables, and related materials by its subsidiaries. The holding company earns dividends and service fees from controlled subsidiaries. Sales channels include direct contracts with utilities and EPCs, bidding for public projects, and indirect sales through distributors. Export sales are conducted under FOB and DDP terms with payment terms typically involving T/T within 30 to 60 days.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in Vietnam’s power cable industry, being the top local manufacturer with competitive advantages in quality, cost, and product range including high-voltage underground cables. It competes with global cable manufacturers in Southeast Asia and faces high entry barriers due to capital intensity and technological requirements. In rare earths, it aims to establish a competitive supply chain outside China leveraging local resources and LS Group’s refining expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the consolidated revenue reached approximately KRW 731 billion, with operating profit of KRW 29.5 billion and net profit of KRW 4.3 billion. The company has four subsidiaries and total assets of about KRW 408 billion. Despite a revenue decline from the previous year due to slower domestic demand, profitability improved through high-value product sales and operational efficiency. The company maintains a strong capital base with equity around KRW 156 billion and is actively managing debt and liquidity risks.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: LS Eco Energy emphasizes superior product quality, technological expertise, and strong local market presence as key differentiators. Its subsidiaries offer a broad product portfolio including high-voltage underground cables not produced by local competitors, enabling them to secure large infrastructure projects. The company leverages LS Group’s global brand and technical know-how to provide reliable, cost-competitive solutions tailored to customer needs. Its strategic expansion into subsea cables and rare earth materials positions it to capture emerging growth opportunities in renewable energy and eco-friendly technologies.
